Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: George Kaleniecki <geokalen@hotmail.com>
Sent: Friday, September 29, 2017 11:34 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Are you High 
 
Good morning Anthony, hundreds of managers and coaches available in the minor leagues and you pitch another reject for the Tigers.30 organizations around the league and you pick a washed up has been. All you have to do when looking for a new manager is look at the successful ones in each organizations system. Which ones are sending up ballplayer after ballplayer that have learned proper fundamentals in the minors and stepping right into starting lineups. Why ask for more trouble unless of course you are thinking of a language barrier. It would be nice to actually understand what a person is trying to say in English instead of some mumble jumble. We get that when we call someone for service, press 1 for esplanade 2 for India and so on. There are many MANAGERs in the minors if you are willing to look and pay for which th Tigers never did with Ausmus. And there is no one in the Tigers Organization that even know how to teach basic baseball fundamentals because the Tigers are one of the worst clubs anymore. Please put away you pencil or I pad and try another sport Anthony because baseball is one you never learned to play properly. Sorry, but it shows in your writing. Have a nice day, George Kaleniecki 313-410-8024 geokalen@hotmail.com
